blogs.title: The Comeback Kid: How xLSTM is Challenging the Transformer Era
blogs.description: A beginner-friendly overview of the xLSTM paper, exploring the history of LSTMs, their fall from grace due to Transformers, and how this new 'extended' version brings them back into the AI spotlight.

blogs.title: Saying Goodbye to Scalar Memory: The Matrix Magic of mLSTM
blogs.description: A deep dive into the mLSTM (Matrix LSTM), explaining how upgrading from a scalar memory cell to a matrix memory cell solves the original LSTM's storage limitations and enables fully parallelizable processing.

blogs.title: Exponential Gating: Giving LSTMs the Power to 'Forget' Efficiently
blogs.description: An exploration of the sLSTM (Scalar LSTM) and its groundbreaking exponential gating mechanism. We break down how this tweak allows the model to better revise its storage decisions, overcoming a major flaw in classic LSTMs.

blogs.title: David vs. Goliath: Benchmarking xLSTM Against Transformers and State Space Models
blogs.description: A breakdown of the paper's experiments, comparing xLSTM's performance, scaling laws, and efficiency against state-of-the-art architectures like Transformers (Llama) and State Space Models (Mamba) in large language modeling tasks.

blogs.title: Building xLSTM: Residual Blocks and the Anatomy of a Modern RNN
blogs.description: A look under the hood at the xLSTM architecture, explaining how researchers combine sLSTM and mLSTM blocks using pre- and post-up-projection residual backbones to build a highly scalable, modern deep learning model.
